facts.business: Chemkart India Limited is engaged in the trading and value-added processing (blending and grinding) of nutraceutical, health and sports-supplement ingredients across seven categories, supplied on a B2B basis, with backward integration through subsidiaries.

segments.name: Trading of nutraceutical and health-supplement ingredients
Processing (blending and grinding) of raw materials into customer-specific formulations
Backward-integrated marketing and trading of nutraceutical products through subsidiaries

capacity_or_capex.timeline: ~28,259 sq. ft. at Kalher, Bhiwandi, Thane, Maharashtra

auditor.name: Bagaria & Co. LLP, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding uncertainty relating to outcome of pending litigation with Customs Authorities; Rs. 1,474.26 lakhs paid as Custom Duty shown as recoverable, no provision considered necessary.

key_risks: Dependence on continuous and timely supply of raw materials/traded products from key suppliers, absence of long-term or exclusive supply arrangements
Geographical concentration of operations, with revenue and facilities significantly weighted towards the Mumbai Metropolitan Region
Exposure to volatility in global commodity prices and foreign exchange rates affecting imported ingredients
Regulatory risk given evolving compliance landscape for nutraceutical, food and health-supplement products (FSSAI)
Working-capital intensity due to inventory carrying and credit extension to customers
Integration risk associated with recently acquired subsidiaries (Easy Raw Materials Private Limited and Vinstar Biotech Private Limited) and their planned expansion into manufacturing
General macroeconomic, interest-rate and credit-risk factors affecting customers' ability to pay and the Company's cost of borrowing
